description: SSA Substantial Gainful Activity (SGA) thresholds by year. If monthly earnings exceed the threshold, the claimant is generally considered to be performing SGA and is not eligible for disability benefits.
notes: Non-blind SGA amounts are updated annually based on the national average wage index.
Blind SGA amounts are updated annually and are significantly higher than non-blind amounts.
Self-employed individuals are evaluated differently — by the value of their work contribution, not just net income.
The Trial Work Period allows beneficiaries to test their ability to work for up to 9 months without losing benefits.
